parameters.jsCode: const crypto=require('crypto'); const fail=(statusCode,error)=>[{json:{ok:false,statusCode,error}}]; const authorization=$json.headers?.authorization??''; if(!authorization.startsWith('Bearer ')) return fail(401,'Sesión requerida.'); const secret=$env.JWT_SECRET; if(!secret) return fail(500,'JWT_SECRET no está configurado.'); try { const [h,p,s,x]=authorization.slice(7).trim().split('.'); if(!h||!p||!s||x) throw new Error(); const expected=crypto.createHmac('sha256',secret).update(`${h}.${p}`).digest('base64url'); const l=Buffer.from(s),r=Buffer.from(expected); if(l.length!==r.length||!crypto.timingSafeEqual(l,r)) throw new Error(); const payload=JSON.parse(Buffer.from(p,'base64url').toString('utf8')); if(!payload.exp||payload.exp<=Math.floor(Date.now()/1000)) throw new Error(); const role=String(payload.rol??payload.role??'').toUpperCase(); const permissions=(Array.isArray(payload.permisos)?payload.permisos:[]).map(v=>String(v).toLowerCase()); if(role!=='ADMINISTRADOR_PARKING'&&!permissions.includes('parqueadero.gestionar')) return fail(403,'No tiene permisos para configurar parqueadero.'); const body=$json.body??{}; const modality=String(body.modality??'').toUpperCase(); const vehicleType=String(body.vehicleType??'').toUpperCase(); const amount=Number(body.amount); const active=body.active; if(!['DIARIO','MENSUAL'].includes(modality)) return fail(400,'Seleccione una modalidad válida.'); if(!['AUTO','MOTO'].includes(vehicleType)) return fail(400,'Seleccione un tipo de vehículo válido.'); if(!Number.isFinite(amount)||amount<0||amount>99999999.99) return fail(400,'Ingrese un precio válido.'); if(active===true&&amount<=0) return fail(400,'Una tarifa activa debe tener un precio mayor a cero.'); if(typeof active!=='boolean') return fail(400,'El estado de la tarifa no es válido.'); return [{json:{ok:true,modality,vehicleType,amount:Math.round(amount*100)/100,active}}]; } catch { return fail(401,'La sesión es inválida o ha vencido.'); }

parameters.query:
WITH inserted AS (
  INSERT INTO public.parqueadero_modalidades (modalidad, tipo_vehiculo, precio, activo)
  SELECT $1, $2, $3::numeric(10,2), $4::boolean
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM public.parqueadero_modalidades
    WHERE modalidad = $1 AND tipo_vehiculo = $2
  )
  RETURNING id, precio, activo
)
SELECT
  COALESCE((SELECT TRUE FROM inserted LIMIT 1), FALSE) AS success,
  (SELECT id::int FROM inserted LIMIT 1) AS id,
  (SELECT precio::double precision FROM inserted LIMIT 1) AS amount,
  (SELECT activo FROM inserted LIMIT 1) AS active,
  CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM inserted) THEN 'Ya existe una tarifa para esa modalidad y tipo de vehículo.' ELSE NULL END AS error,
  CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM inserted) THEN 409 ELSE 201 END AS "statusCode";
